get.description: The signed-in user. `active_org_id` is set once the active org is set up in Trellis.

The user's orgs, pending invitations, and — if the active org is set up —
their effective permissions there. The frontend uses this to show or hide
navigation and the admin console.

post.description:
Set up the active Clerk org in Trellis: the org, its root `Admin` role and the
creator as Admin. Called by the /onboarding page. Returns 201 the first time,
200 if the org was already set up.

get.description: The active org's name and description. `can_edit_description` = caller holds the root Admin role (D35).

patch.description: Save the org description (up to 1,000 characters; empty clears it). Root Admin role only (D35).

get.description:
Every role in the org as a flat list with `depth`. `manageable` marks the roles
the caller may edit or delete (strictly below their org-level role).

post.description:
Create a role under the caller's org-level role or a role below it, holding
only permissions the caller has (D17).

patch.description:
Rename, move or change the permissions of a role below the caller. Missing fields
are left unchanged. The Admin role can't be changed (D17).

delete.description:
Delete a role below the caller. Refused (409) while roles sit under it or a
member, invitation or document still uses it.

get.description: Everyone in the org with their org-level role, plus pending invitations (D25).

post.description:
Add someone by email with an optional org-level role below your own (D26).
`status` is "added" if they already use Trellis, "invited" if Clerk emailed them.

patch.description:
Change someone's org-level role (`role_id: null` = no role). Only for people whose
every role is below yours (D38), and only to a role you could invite them with.

delete.description:
Remove someone from the org: out of the Clerk org, off every team, out of the
org (D10-C, D38). Their tasks, strikes and documents stay.

Cancel a pending invite: revoked in Clerk (the email link stops working), then
removed. Only for invites with no role or a role below yours.

get.description: Every document the caller may see, newest first, with its indexing status.

post.description:
Register a file already uploaded to UploadThing and start indexing it.
Returns at once with status 'processing'; poll GET /documents/{id} until
it is 'ready' or 'failed'. Tag must be at or below the caller (D23).

get.description: Where the caller may tag a new document: org, roles and teams (D23). Fills the upload dialog's picker.
One document the caller may see (used to poll indexing status).

patch.description:
Change a document's title, description or who sees it (D39). Allowed for anyone
who could upload it where it is now, and to the new audience. The chat follows
the new audience at once.

delete.description:
Delete a document and its indexed pieces. Allowed for anyone who could upload
a document with the same tag (D23).

get.description: Every team the caller is on or oversees (D13/D29), with card data and button flags.

post.description: Create an empty team (org-level create_team). The creator doesn't join it (D29).

delete.description: Delete a team you oversee (D31). 409 team_not_empty while it has tasks, strikes or documents.

get.description: One team with its members. 404 team_not_found if the caller can't view it.

post.description: Add an existing org member with a team role below yours (D25, D30).

delete.description: Take someone off the team; only people whose team role is below yours (D30).

get.description: Add member dialog: org members not on the team, and the roles the caller may give here (D30).

Tasks the caller can see (teams they're on or oversee), soonest deadline first.
Filters: one team, only mine, a status, only overdue. Each task has can_edit /
can_change_status for its buttons (D33).

post.description: Create a task for a team member ranked below you (needs assign_task in that team, D32).

patch.description:
Change a task; only the fields sent change. The assignee may change only the
status; managers above the assignee may change anything (D33).

delete.description: Delete a task; only managers above the assignee (D33).

get.description: Liveness probe — returns 200 if the process is running.

ActiveOrgPermissions.title: ActiveOrgPermissions
ActiveOrgPermissions.description:
Effective permissions in the token's active org (D4, D9, D13).
For showing/hiding UI only — the backend still enforces every action.

AddTeamMemberRequest.title: AddTeamMemberRequest
AddTeamMemberRequest.description: An existing org member (D25) and the team role to give them (D30).

CreateTaskRequest.title: CreateTaskRequest
CreateTaskRequest.description: D32: the assignee is required and must be a team member ranked below the creator.

DocumentTagOptions.title: DocumentTagOptions
DocumentTagOptions.description: Where the caller may tag a new document (D23). The upload dialog's picker shows exactly these.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: The error body, published in OpenAPI so the frontend's generated types include it.

TeamCandidatesResponse.title: TeamCandidatesResponse
TeamCandidatesResponse.description: Choices for the Add member dialog.

TeamDetailResponse.title: TeamDetailResponse
TeamDetailResponse.description: /teams/[teamId]: the card's data plus the member list.

TeamResponse.title: TeamResponse
TeamResponse.description: One card on /teams: name, your place in the team, members, task numbers.

UpdateDocumentRequest.title: UpdateDocumentRequest
UpdateDocumentRequest.description:
Edit a document (D39). A missing field is left unchanged. To change who sees it,
send scope_type with the id it needs (role_id / team_id), exactly as on upload.

UpdateRoleRequest.title: UpdateRoleRequest
UpdateRoleRequest.description: Edit or move a role. A missing (or null) field is left unchanged.

UpdateTaskRequest.title: UpdateTaskRequest
UpdateTaskRequest.description:
Only the fields sent change. The assignee may send only `status`; managers
may send anything (D33). `deadline: null` clears the deadline; title, assignee
and status can't be cleared (D32: no unassigned tasks).
